dossier.headline: HAL's Q2 profit rises but margins slip; shares fall
dossier.summary: HAL reported higher Q2 FY27 profit on November 12, but EBITDA grew more slowly than revenue and margins narrowed. The shares fell 2.3% to ₹4,835.1 by 1:40 PM, with other reports putting the fall at over 3%.
why_it_matters: Profit growth did not stop the selling because margins narrowed
